title: A first project you can verify
summary: Inspect Orbit Notes, migrate a saved prompt into a skill, test project guidance, compare search fixes, and practice targeted recovery plus durable Git checkpoints.
outcome: The starter moves from four passing/two failing checks to six passing checks. Compare a plausible 5/6 alternative, preserve unrelated edits, and inspect the separate real two-commit demonstration.
expected: Four integration tests pass when Git is installed. The depth demo checks nine distinct artifacts and counterexamples. Run verify-commit.cjs separately for actual commit coverage and HEAD evidence.

title: Turn an event stream into a checked report
summary: Separate process/event completion from final-answer validity. Compare two actual source folders and reject wrong-directory output or schema-shaped fabrication.
outcome: Accept source-correct red/blue reports; reject invented commands/URLs, missing fields, crossed sources, malformed events and failed processes. Native capture starts in dry-run mode.
expected: Thirty-two event, subprocess and final-extraction checks pass. The demo checks nine source, plan and failure cases without launching an authenticated Codex task.

title: A reusable review skill with a test boundary
summary: Inspect a complete skill, compare relevant and irrelevant requests, and review real fixture files without inventing missing facts.
outcome: The helper returns source-grounded findings and explicit unknowns. The rubric separates deterministic helper results from actual skill invocation in a client.
expected: Eighteen package, helper and scratch-setup checks pass. Native skill selection and answer accuracy are separate client exercises, not inferred from helper output.

title: A local MCP server you can inspect
summary: Exchange real newline-delimited JSON-RPC messages with a read-only subprocess server, then inspect tools, resources and failure responses.
outcome: Initialization, discovery, tool calls and resource reads return the supplied fictional tasks. Invalid requests, unknown IDs and missing sources remain explicit.
expected: Twenty local protocol, setup and replacement-client checks pass, including stale-turn, malformed-tail and process-failure cases. Native no-turn MCP discovery was separately checked on the documented author CLI; model-selected invocation remains a learner exercise.

title: Two work packages, one integrated result
summary: Give separate ownership of normalization and reporting, enforce the interface contract, and integrate the two actual code changes.
outcome: The reference returns total = 4, done = 2, doneMinutes = 55 and satisfies five integration predicates. The learner starter intentionally fails four candidate tests until repaired.
expected: Nine baseline, reference and actual Git-worktree checks pass when Git is installed. The separate learner candidate starts red. Worktrees isolate files; they do not prove agents were spawned.

title: A preventive hook with an observable decision
summary: Build a preventive patch guard and an artifact-linked Stop check, then prepare a complete disposable project for a deliberate native observation.
outcome: Distinguish allowed, denied, malformed and irrelevant events. Reject stale or missing artifact evidence, allow a complete result, and bound repeated Stop continuation.
expected: Eighteen handler, artifact and workspace checks pass. The demo replays fictional events; native hook trust and interception remain a separate documented learner track.

title: A complete multicomponent workflow package
summary: Build and extend an actual skill/tool/MCP package, rehearse isolated native installation, and learn versioned release, update, rollback and removal.
outcome: The missing-both extension produces two grounded findings through direct and stdio checks. Inspect the actual installed version separately from native chat selection and hook trust.
expected: Twenty-four structural, behavioral, extension and subprocess checks pass. Two native metadata lifecycle versions were separately rehearsed on the documented author CLI; no authenticated model run or owner installation is implied.
